section_metadata.title: Patent Lost-Profits Damages — But-For Causation Rules
section_metadata.notes: Structural Causal Graph: X = Infringing Product (1 = Available, 0 = Absent), Z = Third-Party Non-Infringing Substitute Product (1 = Available, 0 = Absent), Y = Lost Profits Claim Validity (AWARDED or DENIED).

definitions.text: A product that infringes the patentee's patent, available in the market.
A product offered by a third party that does not infringe the patentee's patent and could serve as a substitute for consumers.
Whether the patentee's claim for lost profits damages is valid.

A patentee is entitled to lost profits damages only if they can prove they would have made the infringer's sales 'but for' the infringement. If a non-infringing substitute is available, consumers would have purchased that substitute instead, breaking the but-for causal chain.

rule_units.label: Substitute product available defeats lost-profits claim regardless of infringer presence

statement.method: Rule: Z=1 → DENIED. A non-infringing substitute product breaks the but-for causal chain regardless of X.

conditions.description: Third-Party Non-Infringing Substitute Product is available

statement.purpose: If a non-infringing substitute product is available in the market, consumers would have purchased that substitute instead of the patentee's product, even absent the infringement. This breaks the but-for causal chain.
statement.verbatim_source_span: A non-infringing substitute product breaks the but-for causal chain.

rule_units.label: No substitute and infringer present establishes but-for causation for lost profits

statement.method: Rule: Z=0 AND X=1 → AWARDED. No substitute + infringer present = but-for causation established.

conditions.description: Third-Party Non-Infringing Substitute Product is not available
Infringing Product is available in market

statement.purpose: When no non-infringing substitute is available and the infringing product is present, the patentee would have captured the infringer's sales but for the infringement.
statement.verbatim_source_span: No substitute + infringer present = but-for causation established.

rule_units.label: No substitute and no infringer means no lost sales to recover

statement.method: Rule: Z=0 AND X=0 → DENIED. No substitute and no infringer means no lost sales to recover.

conditions.description: Third-Party Non-Infringing Substitute Product is not available
Infringing Product is absent from market

statement.purpose: Without an infringing product there can be no damages, regardless of substitute availability.
statement.verbatim_source_span: No substitute and no infringer means no lost sales to recover.
